description: Cancels a resting order on the venue by its venueOrderId (as returned by place_order). Requires an active venue connection; the cancellation is signed by Riv's gateway. A failed cancel (e.g. order already filled) is reported as a normal outcome, not an error.

clientOrderId.description: Idempotency key. REUSE the same value when retrying this exact cancel; new intent = new value. Auto-generated if omitted.

venueOrderId.description: The venue order id returned by place_order.

name: cancel_order
title: Cancel order (Riv)
